summary: Local service recovery rejects ambiguous native success selection and rechecks journal observations after receipt retrieval. Observations seal once; live reads verify inventory and selected disk records. Managed native workflows persist bounded attempt identities before RPC, fencing missing journal history after restart and rejecting failed evidence commits before transport. Active/recovery-blocked parent history is protected within the existing journal cap; matching ordinary terminal parents release it. Compact retention queries stay outside the journal process, and storage failure cannot prune evidence or poison healthy reads. The shared receipt API also revalidates the exact selected observation after lookup, rejecting stale completions without replay or retention renewal. This is bounded SQLite/memory source evidence, not new live Agent, atomic cross-store publication, joint rollback, live PostgreSQL, power-loss or installed qualification.
